sentences.text: In 1915, a French soldier found a live rat inside his helmet.
The rat escaped, but the soldier remained unharmed.
The next day, the same rat was found in another soldier's helmet.
Soldiers began referring to it as 'the rat patrol'.
Doctors thought the rats might spread disease, but they were actually just curious about the phenomenon.
The rats were harmless, yet the story became a symbol of the war's absurdity.
This showed how war could turn even the smallest event into a major mystery.
Soldiers shared the story as a way to cope with the chaos and fear of war.
The rat patrol became a symbol of how war can make the ordinary feel strange and dangerous.
Even today, the story reminds us of the human side of war and the strange things that happen in conflict.
